startPageOutOfRange: [nekos-moe] With {pageSize} images per page you can reach at most page {maxPage} (site limit skip ≤ {maxSkip}); start page {startPage} is out of range
endPageClamped: [nekos-moe] With {pageSize} images per page you can reach at most page {maxPage}; end page {endPage} will be treated as {maxPage}
noResults: [nekos-moe] Page {page} returned no results; reached the last page
pageShort: [nekos-moe] Page {page} has fewer than {pageSize} images; reached the last page
